review.editorial_summary: Completed the JavaScript LAS implementation; unchanged source passes all 223 tests under LAS 2.0.4.

The LAS 2.0.4 result remains 223/223, matching the prior 2.0.3 score. The original generation grade was 223/223 under LAS 2.0.3. This official zero-inference regrade uses the committed 2.0.4 suite and the pinned offline Docker image. Its complete 223-node outcome mapping matches the independently validated scratch report. All 222 unchanged node outcomes match the 2.0.3 baseline; only the renamed negative is semantically replaced. The new negative declares external waveform storage while retaining internal packet data and keeps the internal bit clear; it does not duplicate the both-bits-set check. Acceptance/rejection solely for a clear deprecated internal bit remains unscored.  No remaining failed cases were observed. Full original transcript/source reviews are carried forward with their reviewer, content hash and path below. Those earlier reviews are historical evidence; their former tool-count exactness claims are superseded by the current session-based audit. Audited v2 tool calls: 24; preserved original recorded count: 24. Input, output, cache and reasoning totals reparse exactly and remain complete; all token/cost fields and generation metadata are preserved. Regrading adds no model calls or generation cost. Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.

payload.editorial_summary: Completed the Node.js LAS implementation and passed all 223 evaluation tests. Its 21 local tests cover every point format, record validation, exact 64-bit integers, waveform payloads, and CLI error handling.
payload.notes: Completed voluntarily after implementing standard-library JavaScript inspect/render codecs and correcting two issues in its own test fixture (a syntax typo and an off-by-one file-size expectation). The final transcript records 21/21 local tests passing; independent grading built successfully and passed 223/223 cases with no skips or errors. Source spot-checks confirmed proper CLI envelopes, exact BigInt JSON handling, standard-record validation even through opaque inputs, preservation of embedded GeoASCII NULs, and zero-descriptor waveform handling. All 29 completed canonical items were reviewed: five agent messages, 18 command executions, and six file changes. The v2 tool count is exactly 24; no missing-canonical rejection or ambiguous failed wrapper was found. Input/output/cache/reasoning totals match both preserved final usage and adapter reparse, with is_partial=false. Cost is an estimate ($3.688344), not a reported charge. No observed scoring, generation, grading, authentication, or isolation issue requires a rerun. Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.
